en.singleInstanceError:
The single-instance check or activation of the existing window failed. This launch cannot continue. Review the cause and retry.

{{error}}
en.launchProtectionTitle: CC GUI could not start inside its protection boundary
en.launchProtectionBody:
Launch protection did not pass. This start will not open a window or fall back to a direct connection.

{{error}}
en.proxy_not_approved: The network proxy is off, or its address is not http://127.0.0.1:7897.
en.claude_bin_not_approved: The Claude path is not the reviewed local program.
en.settings_unreadable: The local proxy settings could not be read.
en.proxy_preflight_failed: The local proxy preflight did not pass.
en.claude_firewall_not_ready: The Claude firewall boundary is not ready.
en.gui_firewall_not_ready: The CC GUI firewall boundary is not ready.
en.webview_proxy_not_ready: The WebView2 proxy policy is not ready.
en.protection_check_failed: A protection check could not finish.
